title: %random — seeded random number in range
purpose: Generate a deterministic random integer within an inclusive range using a string seed.
notes: With min and max supplied, the result is an integer in the inclusive range [min, max].
A string seed makes the result deterministic; the same seed always yields the same value.
Without a seed the result is non-deterministic, so corpus usage should always pass a seed.

avoid.why: without a seed the generator is non-deterministic; supply a string seed for reproducible output
